articles.title: Far Side Moon Rocks Help Explain the Moon's Two Faces
articles.summary: Rocks from the Moon's far side suggest that uneven heating from Earth's gravity helped give the Moon two very different sides.

articles.title: Fossil Forgotten in a Museum Drawer Reveals a New Dinosaur
articles.summary: A skull fossil overlooked for nearly a century is a new claw-armed dinosaur and the first megaraptoran found in Europe.

articles.title: Computers Find Thousands of Hidden Steps in Turning CO2 Into Fuel
articles.summary: Using AI, scientists found 9,389 reactions involved in turning carbon dioxide into methanol, including a surprising role for hydrogen.
